wargear.name: Strategos slate
wargear.summary: A cogitator slate loaded with the Codex's battle-plans and the day's terrain surveys.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Strategos slate adds 1 to its Cool and Intelligence Characteristics.

wargear.name: Praetorian hoplon
wargear.summary: A tall tower shield blazoned with the Ultramar omega.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Praetorian hoplon, all Models in that Unit have an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless they already have a better Invulnerable Save. If the Model carrying the hoplon is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Ultramar fire-control array
wargear.summary: Range-finders and a dedicated gunnery cogitator, run to Ultramar tolerances.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with an Ultramar fire-control array adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

wargear.name: Standard of Macragge
wargear.summary: A tall eagle standard of Ultramar.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Standard of Macragge, all Models in that Unit have the Rally to the Eagle Special Rule. If the Model carrying the Standard is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Fleet-linked vox-array
wargear.summary: A vox-array tied to the fleet net.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Fleet-linked vox-array has the Orchestrated Advance Special Rule.

wargear.name: Oath-scroll of Macragge
wargear.summary: A scroll of oaths sealed in wax.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Oath-scroll of Macragge adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic and has the Macragge Oath Special Rule.

wargear.name: Bulwark plates
wargear.summary: Heavy shield-plates that lock together into a wall.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Bulwark plates, all Models in that Unit have the Bulwark Stance Special Rule. If the Model carrying the plates is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Gyro-stabiliser
wargear.summary: A turret ring stabilised by a gyro-mass.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Gyro-stabiliser has the Gyro-Lock Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ablative bulwark
wargear.summary: Cladding that breaks up long-range hits.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with an Ablative bulwark has the Bulwark Cladding Special Rule.

wargear.name: Faithful spirit core
wargear.summary: A machine spirit steeped in the Codex.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Faithful spirit core has the Dutiful Spirit Special Rule.

option.text: The Sergeant may take an Ultramar pattern weapon
Up to three Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
The unit may carry Praetorian hoplons
May be fitted with an Ultramar fire-control array
The Strike Leader may exchange the Argean power sword for
The unit may carry a Standard of Macragge
Praetor's Regalia: may take up to two relics
The Sergeant may order Bulwark plates for the unit
May take an Ultramar vehicle fitting
Up to two models may carry a Phalanx lance
One model may carry a Pilum launcher

modifiers.text: Drilled to the Codex: +1 LD, -1 I.
Eagles of the storm: +1 WS, -1 T.
Standard of Macragge: Rally to the Eagle.
Oath-scroll of Macragge: +1 CL, Macragge Oath.

rules.name: Drilled Cohorts
rules.summary: Five hundred men, one drill, no wasted motion.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when it makes a Check to avoid gaining a Tactical Status. While a friendly Centurion is within 6" of the Unit, it passes Morale Checks automatically.

rules.name: Shield Wall
rules.summary: The shields lock and the line becomes a rampart.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks, provided it did not Rush in its most recent Movement phase.

rules.name: Eagle Strike
rules.summary: The Locutarus falls on the target before it knows it is hunted.
rules.text: In the Battle Turn in which a Unit with this Special Rule arrives from Reserves by Deep Strike, Hit Tests made for its Shooting Attacks are made with a +1 modifier. The Unit may Rush in that Battle Turn but cannot Charge.

rules.name: Vengeance of Calth
rules.summary: Calth is not forgotten and will not be forgiven.
rules.text: While an enemy Word Bearers Unit is within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, each friendly Ultramarines Unit within 12" of that Model passes Morale Checks automatically and adds 1 to the result of its Charge Rolls against Word Bearers Units.

rules.name: Rally to the Eagle
rules.summary: Where the eagle stands, the line reforms.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Controlling Player's Battle Turn, the Controlling Player may declare that a Unit with this Special Rule rallies. That Unit and each friendly Ultramarines Unit within 6" of it removes all of its Tactical Statuses.

rules.name: Orchestrated Advance
rules.summary: The fleet net places every brother where he is needed.
rules.text: Once per battle, a friendly Ultramarines Unit in Reserves that arrives within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule does not risk a Mishap on arrival.

rules.name: Macragge Oath
rules.summary: An oath sworn on Macragge is kept in front of witnesses.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule cannot be forced to decline a Challenge. While it is engaged in a Challenge, it adds 1 to its Weapon Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Bulwark Stance
rules.summary: Planted behind the plates, they give no ground.
rules.text: If a Unit with this Special Rule has not moved in its Controlling Player's current Battle Turn, its Models add 1 to their Cover Saves against Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Gyro-Lock
rules.summary: The turret rides level through any manoeuvre.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule does not suffer any penalty to Hit Tests for having moved in its Controlling Player's current Battle Turn.

rules.name: Bulwark Cladding
rules.summary: Long-range hits skip and shatter on the cladding.
rules.text: If the attacker is more than 18" away, the AP of each Shooting Attack made against a Vehicle with this Special Rule is worsened by 1 (for example, AP 3 becomes AP 4), to a worst of AP 6. A Shooting Attack with no AP is unaffected.

rules.name: Dutiful Spirit
rules.summary: The machine-spirit keeps the Codex even when the crew falters.
rules.text: Once per battle, a Vehicle with this Special Rule ignores one Crew result that would otherwise affect it.

rites.name: The Five Hundred Muster
rites.flavor: Every world of Ultramar sends its sons, and every son has drilled the same manoeuvres since boyhood.
benefits: Veteran Tactical Squads and Praetorian Breacher Squads may fill Troops slots.
Tactical Squads and Veteran Tactical Squads gain Drilled Cohorts: +1 Cool Characteristic to avoid Tactical Statuses, and automatic Morale Check passes near a friendly Centurion.
limitations: At least two Tactical Squads and a Centurion are required.
No Fast Attack units and no model with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: The Five Hundred Muster: Drilled Cohorts.

require.note: Bring at least two Tactical Squads.
A Centurion must lead the Muster.

rites.name: Phalanx of the Invictus
rites.flavor: Behind the shield-wall of the Suzerains, the rest of the Legion simply refuses to die.
benefits: Invictus Suzerain Squads may fill Troops slots and gain +1 Cool.
They gain Shield Wall: Feel No Pain (6+) against Shooting Attacks if they did not Rush in their most recent Movement phase.
limitations: At least one Invictus Suzerain Squad is required.
No War Engines and no Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Phalanx of the Invictus: +1 CL, Shield Wall.

require.note: Bring at least one Invictus Suzerain Squad.

rites.name: Strike of the Locutarus
rites.flavor: A line of retros against the clouds, and the Eagles of Macragge are already on the roof.
benefits: Locutarus Storm Squads may fill Troops slots.

They add 1 to their Initiative Characteristic and gain Eagle Strike: in the Battle Turn they arrive by Deep Strike, their Shooting Attacks are made with a +1 modifier to Hit Tests (they may Rush, but not Charge, in that Battle Turn).
limitations: They subtract 1 from their Leadership Characteristic.
Locutarus Storm Squads must start the battle in Reserve.
At least one Locutarus Storm Squad is required.
No Armour units and no War Engines.

modifiers.text: Strike of the Locutarus: +1 I, -1 LD, Eagle Strike.

require.note: Bring at least one Locutarus Storm Squad.

rites.name: Remember Calth
rites.flavor: The Legion was shot in the back by its own brothers, and has not yet finished answering.
benefits: Every Ultramarines Unit gains Hatred (Word Bearers) (except the Honoured Telemechrus, which already has it), and every non-Vehicle Model adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic.

Remus Ventanus and the Honoured Telemechrus gain Vengeance of Calth: nearby friendly Units pass Morale Checks automatically and add 1 to Charge Rolls against Word Bearers while an enemy Word Bearers Unit is within 12".
limitations: Remus Ventanus must lead the army.
No Assassins and no Malefic models.

require.note: Remus Ventanus must lead the army.

armyRules.name: Volley Discipline
benefits: If a Unit with this Special Rule did not move in its Controlling Player's current Battle Turn, Hit Tests made for its Shooting Attacks are made with a +1 modifier.
drawbacks: If a Unit with this Special Rule Rushed in its Controlling Player's current Battle Turn, Hit Tests made for its Shooting Attacks are made with a -1 modifier.

armyRules.name: Strategos Gambit
armyRules.flavor: A plan laid out three moves in advance.
benefits: Once per battle, at the start of the Movement phase, the Controlling Player may choose one friendly Ultramarines Unit within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule. That Unit may make a Set-up Move of up to 3" before any other Unit moves.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule cannot Rush in the Battle Turn in which this benefit is used.

armyRules.name: Shield-and-Spear
armyRules.flavor: Tank and infantry fight as one body.
benefits: While a friendly Ultramarines Infantry Unit is within 6" of a Vehicle with this Special Rule, Hit Tests made for its attacks are made with a +1 modifier.
drawbacks: If there is no friendly Ultramarines Infantry Unit within 12" of a Vehicle with this Special Rule, it subtracts 1 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.
